headline: North America drives a profit jump; buyback and outlook up
summary_short: GM's Q3 2026 revenue was $50.0B (+2.9% y/y), EBIT-adjusted $4.1B (+21.6%) and adjusted EPS $3.70 (+32.2%); the board approved a new $20.0B buyback.
summary_long: GM North America EBIT-adjusted rose 43.4% to $3.6B with an 8.7% margin, while GM International fell to $28M from $226M and China equity income dropped to $32M. GM Financial EBT-adjusted was $668M, down 16.9%. Automotive operating cash flow was $8.0B. GM completed its $6.0B buyback, approved a new $20.0B authorization, declared a $0.18 dividend and narrowed 2026 EBIT-adjusted guidance to $14.5-$15.5B; shares outstanding fell to 849M.
confidence_notes: EBIT-adjusted, EPS-diluted-adjusted and adjusted automotive free cash flow are non-GAAP as defined by GM. Shard EPS may reflect either GAAP $3.73 or adjusted $3.70.

drivers.explanation: GM North America EBIT-adjusted rose $1,087M year over year, more than offsetting a $198M decline at GM International.
Net income more than doubled from $1,327M a year ago; the release does not attribute the change to specific items.
Automotive operating cash flow rose $1,979M year over year to $8,049M.
